s: From Longman Dictionary of Contemporary Englishlaudlaud /lɔːd $ lɒːd/ verb [transitive] formalPRAISE to praise someone or something→ See Verb tableExamples from the Corpuslaud• Honig lauded his wife's charity work.Origin laud (1300-1400) Latin laudare, from laus “praise”
